name: Timber boathouse
description: Timber boathouse, 12 x 16 m: weathered vertical board cladding on a concrete base on the land half (z < 0) and timber piles on the water half (z > 0), a dark standing-seam gable roof with its ridge running out over the water, a 6 m open boat bay in the water end over an open slip with a concrete slipway, fenders and cleats, side walkways either side of the slip, a front door in the land end, windows, a winch at the head of the slip. Enterable: boat store (workshop) and walkways at +0.6 m, a loft over the land half up a timber stair, railed along its open edge over the slip head.
notes: Origin on the shoreline (z = 0 at the water's edge): z < 0 stands on land on a concrete base, z > 0 on piles over the water with an open slip. All floors at +0.6 m above the origin; loft at +3.4 m.
